title: Yau's conjecture for the stacked Clifford tori of Wiygul
summary: We prove Yau's conjecture $λ_{1}=2$ for the stacked Clifford tori of Wiygul: for all integers $N\ge2$, $k,\ell\ge1$ and every sufficiently large $m$, every closed embedded minimal surface arising from Wiygul's construction, of genus $k\ell m^{2}(N-1)+1$ in the round three-sphere and resembling $N$ parallel copies of the Clifford torus joined by small catenoidal tunnels, has first Laplace eigenvalue $2$. For $N\ge3$ these surfaces are chains rather than doublings, and the even--odd decomposition on which all previous verifications for gluing constructions rest is not available. The reflection…
